blocks.t: The enclosed kit has been produced by Exidy LI for the Tail Gunner 2 joystick. The purpose of the kit is to modify the wiring of the current joystick firebutton so that the wires are not pinched or cut during joystick manipulation.

The kit consists of a center tube, a spacer adopter, 1 set screw, a 40 “ long white wire, a 20" long black wire, and instructions. To install the replacement kit properly the following steps should be followed. The enclosed drawing shows the position of the old wiring, and the new wiring when correctly installed.
1. Remove the joystick by removing the four screws located at the front and the rear of the mounting plate.
2. Remove the set screw at the bottom of the joystick handle which holds the tube and spacer, It may also be necessary to loosen or remove the set screws in the gimbel followers.
3. Cut and remove the red and white wires as shown in the drawing. It will also be necessary to desolder the wires from the firebutton switch.
4. Pull the firebutton switch out of the assembly, and remove the tube and spacer.
5. Solder the new white and black wires to the firebutton switch.
6. Insert the hollow tube and spacer adopter from the kit into the bottom of the joystick, reinsert and tighten the set screw.
7. Drop the switch with the newly attached wires into place, and feed the two wires through the hollow tube and spacer.
8. Connect the black wire to the cut end of the red wire, and the white wire to the cut end of the white wire as shown in the drawing.
9. Secure the joystick assembly to its mounting by replacing and tightening the four mounting screws.
BLACK WIRE CONNECTS / TO RED WIRE
WHITE WIRE CONNECTS TO WHITE WIRE
